name: inline
description: Find scoped work chats, ask teammates in private threads, monitor Inline events in supported ChatGPT hosts, create child threads, and forward selected messages.

interface.shortDescription: Work with Inline chats, threads, and messages
interface.longDescription: Inline brings scoped work chat into ChatGPT and Codex. Find people and conversations, search history, ask teammates in private threads, monitor replies with MCP Events where supported, create child threads, forward selected messages, upload files, and send messages with explicit write intent.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my unread Inline conversations and highlight what needs my attention
Find the Inline thread about a topic and summarize the decision
Draft a reply to the relevant Inline conversation and ask before sending
